title:
NO-KNEAD FOCACCIA 🫒

Serves 8

500 g bread flour
400 g water
10 g salt
7 g instant yeast
50 ml olive oil

Mix the flour, water, salt and yeast into a shaggy dough.
Rest the dough in the fridge overnight.
Stretch the dough into an oiled tray and dimple it with your fingers.
Bake at 220°C for 25 minutes.
